subcategory_text: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: AC-20, CM-08, PM-05, SA-05, SA-09
implementation_examples: Maintain inventories for all types of software and services, including commercial-off-the-shelf, open-source, custom applications, API services, and cloud-based applications and services
Constantly monitor all platforms, including containers and virtual machines, for software and service inventory changes
Maintain an inventory of the organization's systems
assessment_objectives: Determine whether inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained.

Determine whether activities are conducted to maintain inventories for all types of software and services, including commercial-off-the-shelf, open-source, custom applications, API services, and cloud-based applications and services.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that constantly monitor all platforms, including containers and virtual machines, for software and service inventory changes.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
